title: The Best Policy When the Model Is Known: Value Iteration, the Greedy Move, and the Route the Discount Chooses

artifact.note: the best policy for a task whose model is known: value iteration, which sweeps V(s) = the best over the moves of the move's value until it settles; the greedy move and the greedy policy that the settled values give; a check that the greedy policy's own value is the optimum and beats the policies of 39-01; and the discount's effect on the answer, a low one going the long safe way round the pits and a high one taking the corridor beside them
